extracted.name: Tuna Ball
extracted.description: Chopped pecans blended with tuna, cream cheese, and onion give this tuna ball a light crunch. I love this appetizer with crackers and veggies.
ingredient_lines: 1 (5 ounce) can tuna, drained and flaked
instruction_lines: Blend cream cheese, tuna, 1/2 of the pecans, and onion in a bowl. Shape into a ball or loaf, then coat with remaining pecans. Refrigerate until serving.
